name: Griptape
summary: Python framework for agents, sequential pipelines and parallel workflows, with tools, retrieval engines and task memory that keeps large outputs off prompts.
description: Public Apache-2.0 library on PyPI (griptape 1.13.0; Python 3.10+). Structures compose Tasks into Agents, Pipelines and Workflows. Conversation Memory preserves interactions; Task Memory keeps large or sensitive tool outputs off the model prompt; Meta Memory supplies extra context. Pluggable drivers cover models, storage, retrieval and execution. Provider credentials and inference costs are separate. Griptape Nodes is a distinct visual desktop product.

agent_access.notes: Public source repository; local library. Model services and compute have separate requirements and costs.
